boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten campus places for studying, making, meeting, gaming, research support, cultural connection, events, and student performances.

cards.title: Settle In at the Otter Student Union
cards.subtitle: Study spots, lounges, dining, gaming, and student programs under one roof
cards.notes: Use the public seating for group work, then check the building’s program listings when you want an event or campus connection.
cards.short_summary: A flexible campus hub where students can study, meet, eat, play, and connect with organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUMB describes the Otter Student Union as offering study spots, meeting and lounge space, dining, cultural programs, events, and an esports lounge.
cards.source_title: Otter Student Union | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: Building access and individual room availability vary; call the OSU information desk before relying on a particular space.

cards.title: Choose Your Library Mode
cards.subtitle: Common areas, quiet zones, computers, and reservable rooms
cards.notes: Start in a common area, move to a designated quiet zone for solo work, or reserve a study room when conversation is part of the plan.
cards.short_summary: The main library supports both quiet individual work and collaborative sessions with campus technology nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: The university says the library contains common areas, study rooms, a lounge, a makerspace, technology services, and research-help desks.
cards.source_title: Tanimura & Antle Family Memorial Library's 15th birthday party is Dec. 1
cards.access_notes: The university says members of the public may enter to read, consult materials, study, and use public-access computers; borrowing rules differ.

cards.title: Make Something While You Decompress
cards.subtitle: A collaborative workspace inside the Tanimura & Antle Library
cards.notes: Bring a class project or small creative idea; consult the Makerspace schedule before expecting equipment help or general-access availability.
cards.short_summary: A hands-on library room where creative projects and informal studying can happen side by side.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUMB identifies the Makerspace as a collaborative library workspace with tools and materials; university reporting documents students using it for crafts, class projects, and studying.
cards.source_title: Students create crafts and community in the library's Makerspace
cards.access_notes: Use is tied to general-access hours or scheduled workshops; confirm the current schedule before visiting for specific equipment.

cards.title: Study With Children in Your Care
cards.subtitle: A designated family-friendly room in the campus library
cards.notes: Go to Library Room 2102 when studying with children; keep the six-person occupancy limit in mind and arrange your own childcare.
cards.short_summary: A first-come library room designed for students and others balancing study with caregiving.
cards.evidence_claim: The library identifies Room 2102 as a family-friendly study room available first-come, first-served for people studying with children in their care, with occupancy limited to six.
cards.source_title: Belonging and Access | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: First-come, first-served; maximum occupancy is six including children. The library does not provide childcare.

cards.title: Turn a Study Block Into a Tutoring Session
cards.subtitle: Peer learning support in Library Suite 2125
cards.notes: Check the tutoring schedule before heading to Suite 2125, and arrive with a specific problem, draft, or concept you want to work through.
cards.short_summary: A library-based academic support space where students can pair focused work with tutoring.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUMB’s 2026 Otter Days page locates the Cooperative Learning Center in Library Suite 2125, while the university describes the center as supporting tutoring, peer educators, workshops, and study space.
cards.source_title: CLC Support Team | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: Tutoring and workshops follow posted schedules; consult the Cooperative Learning Center schedule before arriving.

cards.title: Bring an Early Research Question to UROC
cards.subtitle: Research guidance in Library Suite 2150
cards.notes: Schedule a consultation before your visit and bring a rough topic, mentor question, or research goal so the conversation has a clear starting point.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated campus office where undergraduates can begin navigating research opportunities and mentorship.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUMB says UROC is located in Library Suite 2150 and recommends scheduling a consultation as the first step for students interested in undergraduate research.
cards.source_title: Undergraduate Research Opportunities Center (UROC) | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: The office lists Monday–Thursday, 9 a.m.–4 p.m., or by appointment; schedule a consultation for research guidance.

cards.title: Find Community Through OC3
cards.subtitle: Cultural programs and community-building inside the student union
cards.notes: Review OC3’s current programs before visiting, then use an event or training as a concrete entry point for meeting people and participating.
cards.short_summary: A student-union center focused on identity, cultural connection, civic engagement, and social-justice learning.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUMB describes the Otter Cross Cultural Center as a campus space offering events and programs that build community, support identity development, and develop skills.
cards.source_title: Otter Student Union | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: Program schedules and room availability vary; consult OC3 or Otter Student Union listings before visiting for an event.

cards.title: Meet Teammates in the Esports Lounge
cards.subtitle: A dedicated gaming space within the Otter Student Union
cards.notes: Check current lounge access and programming first, then plan a session around the available games, equipment, or organized activities.
cards.short_summary: A named student-union gaming space that gives campus players a shared place to connect.
cards.evidence_claim: The current Otter Student Union page identifies the Otter Esports Lounge as one of the union’s student spaces and says the building offers gaming alongside study and cultural programs.
cards.source_title: Otter Student Union | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: Confirm current lounge hours, eligibility, equipment rules, and event access with the Otter Student Union before going.

cards.title: Watch for the Events That Fill the University Center
cards.subtitle: Auditorium, flexible rooms, living room, and outdoor patios
cards.notes: Track the campus calendar for fairs, meetings, and gatherings here; event attendance is more practical than expecting an open drop-in room.
cards.short_summary: A large event complex where student-facing fairs, orientation activities, and community gatherings come together.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUMB says the University Center includes an auditorium, living room, flexible salons, pre-function space, and patios for conferences, campus events, and community gatherings.
cards.source_title: University Center | California State University Monterey Bay
cards.access_notes: Regular listed hours are Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; after-hours access is event-dependent, and room reservations may involve fees.

cards.title: See Student Work Reach the World Theater Stage
cards.subtitle: A campus venue for music, theater, film, dance, and lectures
cards.notes: Scan the event calendar for student recitals and cultural programs, then verify ticketing and door times for the specific performance you choose.
cards.short_summary: A performance venue where student work and visiting cultural programs meet a campus and community audience.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUMB documents Music and Performing Arts students presenting a family-friendly musical-theater concert at the World Theater and describes the venue as hosting theater, music, dance, film, and lectures.
cards.source_title: CSUMB students perform musical theater highlights at World Theater
cards.access_notes: Access depends on the scheduled event; verify current performance time, ticket requirements, and doors before attending.
